implementationStates: Readiness-reviewed session entry and explicit start
Warm-up, active exercise and set logging, rest, cooldown
Always-available difficulty choice during exercise, rest and pause
Pause/resume, safe stop and saved-session recovery
Routine overview and corrections to manual logs
Completion versus stopped/incomplete summary and return to journal
Local persistence failures and incompatible saved-session recovery
domainRequirements: Use existing structured prescription and eligibility rules; do not infer dosing from appearance or painted concept labels.
Connect the selected journal entry and its reviewed prescription to a local active session; no independent random sample routine.
A difficulty change validates the remaining prescription and explains reductions for readiness/experience; it preserves completed logs and does not itself award damage.
Keep fixed per-exercise and overall progress budgets with a stable ledger; duplicate submissions, corrections, extra reps/load and difficulty toggles cannot farm rewards.
Use correct reps/seconds/minutes and per-side semantics; equipment load is optional user input and is never inferred or prescribed by the avatar.
No timed enemy attacks, character-health loss, real-time combat input, punitive missed-workout debt or pressure to rush rest.
Pain, injury and illness stop the prescription; retain teen supervision and hard-difficulty limits.
Retain the no-equipment pulling-gap disclosure. A character illustration is not an exercise demonstration.
The local example namespace stays separate from real account records and production economy; exercise-professional/youth content review remains pending.
outOfScope: New character classes, skins or color customization
Production cloud training, anti-cheat or trusted reward issuance
Fasting, billing, ads or activity-provider integration
verificationAfterImplementation: Compare actual native Unity captures to the approved composition at multiple landscape sizes and safe insets
Manual logging, retry idempotency, corrections, stop/completion and restart persistence
Difficulty changes during active/rest/paused states preserve logs and capped progress
Fresh readiness and teen/experience eligibility; no automatic workout on entering the window
Readable English/Spanish controls, pointer/keyboard input, pause/exit gating and honest failure states
